INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

Noah sits beside Ava's hospital bed.

NOAH
Are you feeling okay?

AVA
(weakly)
I've been better.

Noah takes her hand.

NOAH
I'm not going anywhere.

AVA
I know.

A nurse enters the room.

NURSE
Visiting hours are over.

CUT TO:

EXT. HOSPITAL - NIGHT

Noah walks toward his car.
